scoring_justification: DFT-computed absolute energies depend on implementation details (pseudopotentials, k-points, relaxation, etc.). Scoring therefore checks physical trends and tolerance to the paper's reported values (±0.3 eV). Full recompute from raw artefacts is infeasible in the lightweight verifier environment.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-derived formation energies for Vac_Ge under Ge-rich at five rhombohedral angles (eV).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 1a; values read from the figure data points at these specific angles.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the reference solution solve.sh which encodes a plausible numerical realisation of the paper's trend. The values are consistent with the paper's claim and fall within the expected range.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These values correspond to the actual paper result; they are used only as reference anchors for the tolerance check, not as the sole scoring criterion.

outputs.description: Computed defect formation energies at the valence band maximum for intrinsic defects in rhombohedral GeTe at five interaxial angles. The checker will verify the structural properties of Ge vacancy formation energy under Ge-rich conditions: monotonic decrease with increasing angle, negative values for angles >= 59°, and consistency with hidden reference values within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: Only the Ge vacancy (Vac_Ge) row under Ge-rich condition for each angle is scored; other rows are provided for completeness.

steps.description: Structural check of Vac_Ge formation energy under Ge-rich: monotonic trend, sign change, and tolerance to paper reference.
